_comment: Times are UTC. Convert from your local time when editing. ET = UTC-4 (DST) or UTC-5 (standard). Each post fires once at the scheduled time. The scheduler tracks fired posts in fired.json (created on first run) so it never double-posts.
_offset_explanation: Set _offset_days to 0 on launch day. The scheduler reads each entry's 'day' field as days from launch. Day 0 = launch day, Day 1 = day after, etc.
